name: @vox-pop/embed
description: Vox Pop embed — standalone Vite + React SPA serving the chrome-less prompt iframe. Cross-origin from apps/web; reads the Vox Pop BFF (@vox-pop/api) directly. Deploys as static assets to embed.voxpop.audio.
//scripts.build: The `emit-version` step writes dist/version.json from COMMIT_SHA/BUILD_TIME so the deploy can assert which commit is being served. This app is an assets-only Worker (no `main` in wrangler.jsonc), so unlike apps/web and apps/public it cannot answer a dynamic route from a deploy-time --var — the value has to be baked in at build time. See the script.

scripts.build:cf: npm --prefix ../.. run build:packages:embed && npm run build

//@types/node: Declared HERE, not inherited from the root. `vite.config.ts` imports `node:url`, and `build:cf` runs `tsc --noEmit` over it — but Workers Builds (and ci.yml's mirror of it) install with `npm ci --workspace=apps/embed`, which installs this workspace and its workspace dependencies and NOTHING from the root package.json, so a root @types/node is not there when it matters. This app was the ONLY one missing the declaration (public, mobile, vox-pop-api and telephony all carry it), which is why vox-pop-embed's Workers Build failed from 2026-09-08 until ci.yml gained a job that mirrors that install. Same reasoning as the esbuild and @antiphony/shared notes in packages/shared/package.json: the only placement that survives every install shape is on the package that needs it.
